name: matrx-apps
description: App corpus for the MATRX renderer — each top-level directory is one app

scripts.check: for d in */manifest.json; do npx matrx check "$(dirname "$d")" || exit 1; done
scripts.bundle: for d in */manifest.json; do app=$(dirname "$d"); npx matrx bundle "$app" -o "dist/$app" || exit 1; done
